Hellflame Quirk.name: Hellflame Quirk
Hellflame Quirk.description:
🔥 You make orange flames from your body and shape your own fire.

🌱 At the start you send palm jets about four meters, burn a door-sized area and make several short bursts before pausing.
📈 With training: cutting streams, flame propulsion, aerial rescues, concentrated bursts that overwhelm tough opponents.
⚠️ You accumulate heat until reactions slow or you collapse; you cannot absorb heat or control unrelated fires, and your flames can burn allies and consume oxygen.
🔗 Canon Drawback, built in: Overheating, as stronger and longer burns build body heat.
🎬 Canon Quirk: Enji Todoroki / Endeavor's Hellflame. You are not related to him; people who know his Quirk notice the resemblance.
🎒 Starts with: Cooling vest

📈 Grants: Power +1, Quirk Output +10, Quirk Control +10, Combat Tactics +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Open Palm Kindling, Burning Boundary Strip
🛡️ Resists: fire
Hellflame Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects:
Scale: orange body flames; normal output spares the skin but heats the body. Start: palm jet about 4 m, door-sized burn, several short bursts before a pause. Fine streams, flight, extreme heat need training.
Limits: heat builds: repeated or focused bursts slow, exhaust, can collapse the user; rest, cooling help; heat worsens it. No ice, heat absorption, dousing all fires or commanding other flames. Fire burns fuel, eats oxygen, makes smoke; allies, passengers unprotected.
Quirk Strain: light: short palm jet, ground strip; moderate: latch burn, thrust, focused stream; heavy: penetrating blast, sustained flight; severe: max output, precision with propulsion.
Drawback: built in, the canon Overheating.
Canon: Enji Todoroki / Endeavor's Quirk; user is unrelated, no tie unless the story makes one; those who know it see the resemblance.
Type: Emitter.
Law: fire near people or property needs self-defense or licensed duty; user owns burns, smoke, spread.
Look: skin flames.
